summary: Avraham Eisenberg opened large opposing MNGO perpetual positions, then bought ~$4M of MNGO across three exchanges that fed Mango's price oracle. The oracle-reported MNGO price jumped over 13x (from ~$0.038 to a peak ~$0.91) within a ~30-minute span, inflating his collateral so he could borrow/withdraw ~$114M and drain the protocol.
